title: VakilFriend Case Data Schema
description: Validates the structured case data extracted from a Vakil-Friend conversation before it is persisted as a CaseEntity or FirRecord.

title.description: Short title describing the case or FIR.

description.description: Full narrative description of the incident or complaint.

petitioner.description: Name of the person filing the case.

target.description: Destination system for the case — court filing or FIR.
